summary: Design microlearning, conversational AI, and embedded workplace guidance. Build practical learning maps and evaluation plans. Explore the course.
lede: AI-powered learning ecosystem design helps L&D leaders and digital workplace product owners connect employee learning with everyday work. The course develops practical skills in mapping capability needs to workflows, creating task-based microlearning and embedded guidance, setting boundaries for conversational AI support, and planning evaluation measures for workplace application.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape workforce learning, talent development, or the digital tools employees use to complete work. It suits people who need to connect capability priorities with practical learning support inside everyday workflows.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of learning and development, talent development, or digital workplace processes is recommended. You do not need programming or machine-learning experience. The course covers AI concepts at conceptual and operational levels; it does not teach production AI engineering. Platform access is not required for the workflow-mapping exercises.
